note: Raw fuzzer input bytes are copied into a null-terminated string without constraining the H3 index value they encode.
The text input is parsed as a 64-bit hexadecimal H3Index even when active resolution digits contain INVALID_DIGIT.
The parsed H3Index is passed directly into h3NeighborRotations from the harness.
For the candidate input the resolution is 1 and digit 1 is 7, so oldDigit becomes INVALID_DIGIT rather than a valid table index less than NUM_DIGITS.
oldDigit equal to 7 indexes past the seven rows of NEW_DIGIT_II, causing invalid memory access in the neighbor calculation.
